lines.text: A woman clothed in the sun, with a crown of twelve stars on her head, cried out in birth pain.
A huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns swept a third of the stars to earth.
Her son was caught up to God, and the woman fled into the city for 1,260 days.
Michael and his angels fought the dragon, who was hurled to the earth with his angels.
The woman was given two wings of a great dove, and the earth swallowed the serpent's river.
